_REPLACE_BEFORE_RUNNING: After deploying staging stack, fill in: treasury, pools[0].address, pools[0].asset, entrypoint. The four PLACEHOLDER zeroes will cause seed-pools.ts to refuse to start until replaced.
_doc: Staging seed config — targets the staging stack deployed via DeployStaging.s.sol with MockUSDC instead of real USDC. Use to dry-run the seed pipeline against a real Sepolia chain without spending real USDC. Mint MockUSDC to your treasury via `cast send STAGING_USDC 'mint(address,uint256)' TREASURY 100000000000`. 15 deposits across 3 denoms = $800 MockUSDC — half of Phase 0 for faster iteration. depositGapMs=2000 (vs Phase 0's 3000) since staging is for iteration, not production observability.
